'''Kachirho''' was a coastal [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] city on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that became the site of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:SWCL_Kachirho.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tree Vikkilynn cutaway]]
Kachirho was located on the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="CL" /> Contrary to most of Wookiee cities built in the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] canopy, Kachirho was located on the shore of the lagoon.<ref name="RotS:TVD" />

Although the city encompassed several inhabited wroshyr trees, including [[Tree Kachirho/Legends|Tree Kachirho]] and [[Tree Vikkilynn/Legends|Tree Vikkilynn]],<ref name="CL" /> and buildings on the ground level,<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> most of the settlement of Kachirho spiraled around the trunk of one massive 300-meter-tall wroshyr tree, known as the [[great tree]].<ref name="RotS:TVD" /> Kachirho also had a city hall located up the beach from the [[Water/Legends|water]]. Two piers and docks extended out into the archipelago.<ref name="BFI guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

As Tree Vikkilynn was the home to the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]], the city was the Wookiee center of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] mapping.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|My home has changed a lot since I was last here. The Empire has exerted much tighter control... and while they've modernized much of Kachirho, they've also dragged their war along with them!|[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW" />}}
The city of Kachirho was founded by members of the [[Kachirho clan]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The leader of the city at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], who had served for over a Human lifetime.<ref name="RotS:TVD" />

[[File:BoK-ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|The Battle of Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], at the end of the Clone Wars, Kachirho was chosen as the landing spot for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] due to its wide-open land areas, as opposed to many other cities on the planet, covered by thick foliage.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|tarfful|Tarfful}}</ref> The Separatists established their beachhead<ref name="SWE3" /> on an island near the city.<ref name="BFI guide" /> When the alarm was sounded that the city would be attacked, thousands from other cities came via land and sea to Kachirho to protect it.<ref name="RotS:TVD" /> The [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] was inserted to beat back a large-scale Separatist [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|assault]] on the [[Kachirho Bridge]]. The commandos fought through large market halls and Wookiee hangars containing [[Wookiee dropship|"balloons,"]] and used four two-barreled [[Missile launcher/Legends|cannons]] located in Kachirho to fire at a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]].<ref name="SW:RC" /> The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] assisted by holding the beach against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Although [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] led the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] into the city, the commando [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] was intercepted by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and declared missing.<ref name="SW:RC" />

A few months later, a group of six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had escaped [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], led by [[Olee Starstone]], came to Kashyyyk looking for Jedi who had been there when Order 66 was issued. Tarfful fought against the Imperials when they [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|invaded]] Kashyyyk, but he was captured by the Empire and became a slave, destined to help build the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

[[File:KachirhoSpaceport.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial-controlled spaceport in Kachirho during the time of the Galactic Civil War]]
After the fall of the Republic, Kachirho was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], where they operated the [[Kachirho Starport|spaceport]]. However, the Empire only minimally garrisoned the city and did not totally control the Wookiee population.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The Empire modernized the city, turned the spaceport into a small military base and built a communication tower. The Empire also allowed the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] to operate in the city. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperial officers stationed there included [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Krieg]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Richards]] and [[Stren Colo]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] stayed at the Imperial outpost, in the Kachirho spaceport. From here, he entrusted his old [[Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] to an Imperial agent to be used to repel a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel Invasion of Kashyyyk|invasion]] force in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Kachirho}}
Kachirho first appeared in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''. It was the site of a battle in [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The battle was recreated in LEGO form for the 2005 video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and its [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]]. The city also appears as a multiplayer map in the [[2007]] video game ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''.
